title: An Open-Source ROS 2 Framework for Shared Control in Surgical Teleoperation: Integrating the Haply Inverse3 with the da Vinci Research Kit
summary: Surgical teleoperation deprives surgeons of touch, forcing visual inference of tissue forces; the commercial platforms now restoring force feedback remain closed, preventing open research on haptic shared control. This paper provides a system contribution: it presents an open-source, ROS 2-native framework that integrates the compact, three-degree-of-freedom (3-DOF) Haply Inverse3 haptic device with the da~Vinci Research Kit (dVRK). The framework includes a novel mapping strategy that combines 3-DOF translational device input with separately tracked VerseGrip orientation into 6-DOF patient-side manipulator commands. Two virtual-fixture-inspired guidance modes serve as reference implementations to evaluate the framework in a within-subjects user study on a teleoperated hot-wire benchmark task in simulation, and the architecture is further demonstrated on physical dVRK hardware. Relative to unassisted manual control, linear guidance significantly reduced both the number of wire contacts and the task completion time, whereas the progressive-stiffness guidance produced consistent but statistically non-significant trends in the same direction. Subjective ratings of workload, agency, and satisfaction showed favorable descriptive trends for the guidance modes. The results demonstrate the feasibility of haptic shared control with a compact device coupled to the dVRK and provide an openly available, reproducible platform for future research. They further suggest that simpler linear feedback may be more robust for inexperienced operators than more complex profiles.
tldr: The paper presents an open-source ROS 2 framework integrating the Haply Inverse3 haptic device with the da Vinci Research Kit for shared-control surgical teleoperation, including a 3-DOF-to-6-DOF mapping strategy and two virtual-fixture guidance modes. A user study shows that linear guidance significantly reduces wire contacts and completion time, demonstrating feasibility of compact haptic shared control for surgical robotics research.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个开源ROS 2框架，将Haply Inverse3触觉设备与达芬奇研究套件（dVRK）集成，用于手术遥操作中的共享控制，包含3自由度到6自由度的映射策略和两种虚拟夹具引导模式。用户研究表明，线性引导显著减少了导线接触次数和完成时间，验证了紧凑型触觉共享控制在外科机器人研究中的可行性。
summary_zh: 外科遥操作剥夺了外科医生的触觉，迫使他们通过视觉推断组织受力；目前商业平台上恢复力反馈的系统仍是封闭的，阻碍了触觉共享控制的开放研究。本文提供了一项系统贡献：它呈现了一个开源的、基于ROS 2的原生框架，将紧凑型三自由度（3-DOF）Haply Inverse3触觉设备与da Vinci研究套件（dVRK）集成在一起。该框架包含一种新颖的映射策略，将3-DOF平移设备输入与单独跟踪的VerseGrip姿态相结合，生成6-DOF患者侧机械臂指令。两种受虚拟夹具启发的引导模式作为参考实现，在模拟环境中的遥操作热丝基准任务上开展了受试者内用户研究以评估该框架，并且该架构还在物理dVRK硬件上进行了进一步演示。与无辅助的手动控制相比，线性引导显著减少了导线接触次数和任务完成时间，而渐进刚度引导则产生了方向一致但统计上不显著的趋势。主观评价的工作负荷、自主感和满意度在描述性趋势上有利于引导模式。结果表明，将紧凑型设备与dVRK耦合实现触觉共享控制是可行的，并为未来研究提供了一个公开可用、可复现的平台。这些结果还进一步表明，对于缺乏经验的操作者而言，简单的线性反馈可能比更复杂的配置文件更为稳健。

title: Design and Evaluation of Epira: An Automated Interview System for Case Investigation and Contact Tracing
summary:
Objective: Case investigation and contact tracing are labor-intensive. Web forms struggle when respondents need clarification before disclosing contacts, and open-ended chatbots may deviate from protocols. We developed and evaluated Epira, a protocol-controlled large language model (LLM) interviewer for multi-disease case investigation and contact tracing.
  Materials and Methods: Epira pairs LLM dialogue with a rule-based controller enforcing required questions, safety handoffs, and a structured case record, and adapts to new diseases by questionnaire upload. Local (Qwen2.5) and cloud (GPT-5.4) backends were tested. Study 1 used 108 simulated cases with ground-truth fields and contacts for measles and gonorrhea under Epira and open-ended conditions (864 sessions). Study 2 enrolled 72 volunteers in a 2$\times$2 disease-by-model interview assessing completion, usability, acceptability, and trust.
  Results: Across Study 1, Epira with a local LLM captured 88.9% of required fields and 60.1% of ground-truth contacts. Open-ended interviewers recovered 31.1-41.9 percentage points fewer required fields than the same models in Epira. In Study 2, completion was 100%; mean adapted System Usability Scale (SUS) was 82.95 $\pm$ 16.17 on a 0-100 scale and mean trust was 3.85 $\pm$ 0.77 on a 1-5 scale.
  Discussion: Protocol control drove completeness more than model choice. Local and cloud deployments produced similar records, supporting privacy-preserving local use with human review of routed interviews and missed contacts.
  Conclusion: Epira recovers required fields and contacts under diverse disclosure conditions, works with local and cloud LLMs, and received favorable usability and trust ratings.
tldr: Epira is a protocol-controlled LLM-based automated interview system for case investigation and contact tracing, using a rule-based controller to enforce required questions and structured case records. Evaluations show it captures more complete data than open-ended chatbots, with high completion, usability, and support for local/cloud LLM deployment.
tldr_zh: Epira 是一个基于协议控制的大语言模型自动访谈系统，用于病例调查和接触者追踪；通过规则控制器强制必答问题并生成结构化记录。评估显示其比开放式聊天机器人能捕获更完整的数据，完成率和可用性高，且支持本地/云端大语言模型部署。
summary_zh:
摘要：目的：病例调查和接触者追踪是劳动密集型工作。当受访者需要在披露接触者之前进行澄清时，网络表单往往难以应对，而开放式聊天机器人可能偏离协议。我们开发并评估了Epira，一种用于多病种病例调查和接触者追踪的协议控制型大语言模型（LLM）访谈系统。
材料与方法：Epira将LLM对话与基于规则的控制器相结合，该控制器强制执行必问问题、安全交接和结构化病例记录，并通过上传问卷来适应新发疾病。测试了本地（Qwen2.5）和云端（GPT-5.4）后端。研究1使用了108例模拟病例，包含麻疹和淋病的真实字段和接触者，在Epira和开放式条件下进行（864次会话）。研究2招募了72名志愿者，进行2×2病种×模型访谈，评估完成度、可用性、可接受性和信任度。
结果：在研究1中，使用本地LLM的Epira捕获了88.9%的必填字段和60.1%的真实接触者。开放式访谈者比Epira中使用相同模型时捕获的必填字段少31.1至41.9个百分点。在研究2中，完成度为100%；平均适应系统可用性量表（SUS）得分为82.95 ± 16.17（0-100分制），平均信任度为3.85 ± 0.77（1-5分制）。
讨论：协议控制对完整性的影响大于模型选择。本地和云端部署产生的记录相似，支持在人工审查路由访谈和遗漏接触者的前提下，采用保护隐私的本地使用方式。
结论：Epira在各种披露条件下均能恢复必填字段和接触者信息，可与本地和云端LLM配合使用，并获得了良好的可用性和信任度评分。

title: Ferrofluid Shape Control with Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Ferrofluids are liquids containing magnetic nanoparticles, enabling shape control through external magnetic fields. This deformability supports their use as soft robotic bodies that can navigate confined spaces and manipulate objects. Their nonlinear continuum dynamics, however, make reliable control challenging. Existing work shows how spatial magnetic fields from electromagnet arrays can establish and maintain desired ferrofluid configurations. A complementary objective is to exploit the fluid's dynamics under limited actuation to reach prescribed shapes that may not be sustainable at equilibrium. Here, we use deep model-based reinforcement learning to control these transient shapes. Learning directly through physical interaction, our policies select current commands for a single fixed electromagnet based on visual observations, guiding the moving ferrofluid toward prescribed geometries. The learned policies repeatedly attain a variety of shapes spanning polygons, asterisks and pentominoes. These results demonstrate that learning directly from physical interaction enables reliable fluid shaping, opening new possibilities for controlling ferrofluid-based soft robots.
tldr: This paper uses deep model-based reinforcement learning to control the transient shapes of ferrofluids under a single fixed electromagnet, learning policies directly from physical interaction with visual observations to reliably form geometries such as polygons, asterisks, and pentominoes.
tldr_zh: 本文使用基于模型的深度强化学习，在单个固定电磁铁驱动下控制铁磁流体的瞬态形状，直接通过物理交互和视觉观测学习策略，并能稳定形成多边形、星形和五连块等几何形状。
summary_zh: 铁磁流体是含有磁性纳米颗粒的液体，可通过外部磁场实现形状控制。这种可变形性使其能够用作软体机器人主体，在受限空间中导航并操纵物体。然而，其非线性连续介质动力学使得可靠控制具有挑战性。现有工作展示了如何利用电磁铁阵列产生的空间磁场来建立并维持所需的铁磁流体构型。一个互补的目标是利用流体在有限驱动下的动力学特性，使其达到平衡状态下可能无法维持的规定形状。在此，我们使用基于模型的深度强化学习来控制这些瞬态形状。我们的策略直接通过物理交互进行学习，基于视觉观测为单个固定电磁铁选择电流指令，引导运动的铁磁流体趋向规定的几何形状。学习获得的策略可重复实现多种形状，涵盖多边形、星形和五格骨牌。这些结果表明，直接从物理交互中学习能够实现可靠的流体成形，为控制基于铁磁流体的软体机器人开辟了新可能性。

title: Auditing black-box clinical prediction models with a large language model through queries alone: a blinded test with planted flaws
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are used to explain clinical prediction models, on the promise that they can say what a model computes, find its faults and even reveal new knowledge in it. We tested the three promises where the answers could be checked. From the International Stroke Trial we trained four kinds of model (logistic regression, explainable boosting machine, gradient-boosted trees, neural network) for two outcomes on patients randomised earlier, planted one flaw in each of 24 copies (an under-predicted subgroup, a reversed risk factor or an implausible step) and mixed them with the 8 clean models. GPT-6 Astra audited each model three times, blind, through a tool that only returned the model's predictions; the judging rules were committed before any run and applied by program. Its surrogate models, with a median of 128 terms, reproduced the audited models' log-odds with a mean $R^2$ of 0.976 (0.959 for an additive surrogate of 42 terms fitted by an analyst). It found the planted flaw in 69 of 72 runs (96%; 95% CI 80% to 99%); a script written for the purpose found all 24. It also reported many more problems: 60% of 1,089 checkable reports failed the pre-specified check against the model's average behaviour; post hoc, most of these were real but small steps, and 15% of the checkable reports were not found in the model. Of 601 unexpected relationships it read out of the clean models, 11% held in patients randomised later (random pairs 6%; a regression scan's shorter list of its strongest candidates, 28%); after a check on the training data, 33% against 30%. With query access alone, an LLM can describe a black-box model faithfully and find nearly every planted flaw, as a purpose-written script also did; its reports of problems must be checked on the model and its discoveries on data.
tldr: This paper tests whether a large language model, with query access alone, can faithfully audit black-box clinical prediction models by describing their behavior, detecting planted flaws, and discovering new knowledge, using blinded runs on stroke outcome models.
tldr_zh: 本文通过盲法测试，检验仅凭查询访问的大型语言模型能否忠实审计黑箱临床预测模型：描述其行为、发现人为植入的缺陷，并挖掘新知识。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）被用于解释临床预测模型，其承诺是它们能够说明模型计算了什么、发现模型的缺陷，甚至揭示其中的新知识。我们对其中可以检验的三项承诺进行了测试。基于国际卒中试验的数据，我们对较早随机分配的患者训练了四种模型（逻辑回归、可解释提升机、梯度提升树、神经网络）用于两个结局，在24个副本中各植入一个缺陷（一个预测不足的亚组、一个反向风险因素或一个不合理的阶梯），并将其与8个干净模型混合。GPT-6 Astra通过一个仅返回模型预测的工具，以盲法对每个模型进行了三次审计；评判规则在运行前预先设定并由程序执行。其替代模型（中位项数为128）再现了被审计模型的对数几率，平均$R^2$为0.976（由分析师拟合的42项加性替代模型为0.959）。它在72次运行中发现了69次植入的缺陷（96%；95% CI 80%至99%）；为此目的编写的脚本发现了全部24个。它还报告了更多问题：在1089个可检查报告中，60%未通过针对模型平均行为的预设检查；事后分析表明，这些大多是真实但微小的阶梯，且15%的可检查报告在模型中未被发现。在它从干净模型中读出的601个意外关系中，有11%在后来随机分配的患者中成立（随机配对为6%；回归扫描对其最强候选者的较短列表为28%）；在对训练数据进行检查后，比例为33%对30%。仅凭查询访问，LLM就能忠实地描述黑箱模型，并发现几乎所有的植入缺陷，正如专用脚本所做的那样；其报告的问题必须在模型上检查，其发现必须在数据上验证。

title: Disentangling Monitor Hardware Artifacts and Smoothing Lag for Shift-Robust Intraoperative EEG and Hemodynamic Risk Calibration
summary: Commercial intraoperative electroencephalography (EEG) and blood pressure monitors introduce cyclic impedance pulses, smoothing delays, direct-current (DC) drift, and cuff holds that confound risk forecasting and uncertainty calibration. We developed a causal signal-conditioning and shift-robust conformal calibration framework across 5,439 public anesthesia procedures. Streaming filters blank 10.13-min 64-Hz impedance checks, apply unclipped post-notch conditioning, separate 63-s suppression-ratio lag, and distinguish three-channel cuff inflations from dropouts across propofol-remifentanil total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA; N = 3,214), volatile anesthesia (N = 2,046), European endoscopy sedation (N = 171), and DC-coupled surgery (N = 8). De-impedanced cortical tree ensembles were compared against deep sequence models, paired with patient-cluster Subgroup-Covariate-Weighted Conformal Risk Control (CRC) and lag-buffered online Conformal Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) tracking. Pre-filter blanking removed 97.90% and 97.60% of false flatline conflicts while preserving 99.23% and 98.96% of deep suppression. On unseen TIVA surgeries (N = 525), cortical features achieved area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) 0.3135 (1.94% prevalence) and 0.1627 (0.82% lag-free prevalence), with no detectable difference from deep encoders (p >= 0.36) and no cortical gain for hypotension (0.3432 vs. 0.3437, p = 0.784). Zero-retraining volatile transfer (N = 1,048) showed no detectable difference from an end-tidal gas oracle on lag-free suppression (0.0820 vs. 0.0736, p = 0.472). Subgroup-Covariate-Weighted CRC bounded all 70 TIVA shift cells at <= 4.38% (alpha = 5.0%) in 66.32 ms per 30-s epoch. Causal artifact disentangling and shift-aware conformal calibration support reliable real-time intraoperative risk bounds within explicit physiological observability limits.
tldr: This paper proposes a causal signal-conditioning and shift-robust conformal calibration framework to remove monitor artifacts (impedance pulses, smoothing lag, DC drift, cuff holds) from intraoperative EEG/hemodynamic data, evaluated on 5,439 anesthesia cases. It shows filtered cortical features match deep sequence models and risk bounds are controlled across shifts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种因果信号调理与移位鲁棒的共形校准框架，用于消除术中脑电/血流动力学监测中的硬件伪影（阻抗脉冲、平滑延迟、直流漂移、袖带充气），并在5439例麻醉手术中验证；过滤后的皮层特征与深度模型相当，且风险界限在分布偏移下得到控制。
summary_zh: 术中脑电图（EEG）和血压监护仪引入的周期性阻抗脉冲、平滑延迟、直流（DC）漂移及袖带保持会对风险预测和不确定性校准产生干扰。我们开发了一种因果信号调理与移位鲁棒保形校准框架，并在5,439例公开麻醉手术中进行了验证。流式滤波器可屏蔽10.13分钟64 Hz阻抗检查，应用未截断的陷波后调理，分离63秒抑制比滞后，并区分三通道袖带充气与信号丢失，覆盖丙泊酚-瑞芬太尼全静脉麻醉（TIVA；N = 3,214）、挥发性麻醉（N = 2,046）、欧洲内镜镇静（N = 171）及直流耦合手术（N = 8）。将去阻抗的皮层树集成与深度序列模型进行比较，并结合患者聚类亚组协变量加权保形风险控制（CRC）及滞后缓冲在线保形比例-积分-微分（PID）跟踪。预滤波器屏蔽清除了97.90%和97.60%的假平线冲突，同时保留了99.23%和98.96%的深度抑制。在未见过的TIVA手术（N = 525）中，皮层特征实现的精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）分别为0.3135（发生率1.94%）和0.1627（无滞后发生率0.82%），与深度编码器相比无显著差异（p >= 0.36），且皮层特征对低血压无增益（0.3432对0.3437，p = 0.784）。零重训练挥发性迁移（N = 1,048）显示，在无滞后抑制方面与呼气末气体参考标准无显著差异（0.0820对0.0736，p = 0.472）。亚组协变量加权CRC将所有70个TIVA移位单元控制在≤4.38%（alpha = 5.0%），每个30秒周期耗时66.32毫秒。因果伪影解析与移位感知保形校准支持在明确的生理可观测性限制内实现可靠的实时术中风险界限。

title: VoxForge: A Unified Foundation Model for Dense 3D Features Across MRI, CT and PET
summary: A unified 3D medical foundation model promises reusable, frozen features that serve a wide variety of tasks such as segmentation, classification and registration on MRI, CT and PET as well as specialist models do. Generalist models still need separate backbones for localized and global tasks, specialist models are confined to a single modality, with the concern that spanning modalities under-emphasizes fine anatomy, and both typically rely on end-to-end fine-tuning to be competitive. We present VoxForge, a single encoder that integrates recent advances in 3D architecture, self-distillation and cross-modal curricula to learn transferable features from permissively licensed MRI and CT volumes. We evaluate it strictly frozen, the test a reusable foundation model must pass, against state-of-the-art generalist and specialist models on segmentation, classification and registration across MRI and CT, and on PET, which it never sees. VoxForge has the best or tied-best average rank in every task group, serves localized and global tasks across modalities at the level of state-of-the-art specialists, and is extremely label-efficient, matching top-performing models on TotalSegmentator CT with a tenth of the labels.
tldr: VoxForge is a single 3D medical foundation encoder trained on MRI/CT via self-distillation and cross-modal curricula, yielding frozen dense features that match specialist models on segmentation, classification, and registration across MRI/CT and unseen PET, with strong label efficiency.
tldr_zh: VoxForge 是一个统一的 3D 医学基础编码器，基于 MRI/CT 通过自蒸馏和跨模态课程学习，冻结特征在 MRI/CT 及未见过的 PET 的分割、分类和配准任务上达到专家模型水平，并具有很高标注效率。
summary_zh: 一个统一的3D医学基础模型承诺提供可重用、冻结的特征，服务于MRI、CT和PET上的分割、分类和配准等广泛任务，其表现可与专科模型媲美。通用模型仍然需要为局部和全局任务分别使用不同的骨干网络，专科模型则局限于单一模态，且存在跨模态会弱化精细解剖结构关注的担忧，同时两者通常依赖端到端微调才能具有竞争力。我们提出VoxForge，一个单一编码器，整合了3D架构、自蒸馏和跨模态课程学习的最新进展，从许可开放的MRI和CT体数据中学习可迁移特征。我们对其进行严格冻结评估——这是可重用基础模型必须通过的测试——并与最先进的通用和专科模型在MRI和CT的分割、分类和配准任务以及其从未见过的PET上进行比较。VoxForge在每个任务组中都取得最佳或并列最佳的平均排名，以最先进专科模型的水平服务于跨模态的局部和全局任务，且极其标签高效，仅用十分之一的标签即可在TotalSegmentator CT上匹配顶尖模型的表现。
